body:
## What it does

Sweeps overnight technology news alongside the mail that genuinely needs a response, then condenses both into one short weekday briefing waiting before you start. Built for writers and editors who need to know what moved while they were asleep. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @techAU shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
